payload.core_mechanism_summary: For each test case, only check pairs where both indices are within the last 4*k elements, as larger indices dominate the product term i*j, making it a greedy heuristic.
payload.rationale: The solution restricts search to the last 4*k indices because larger i,j increase the i*j term significantly, and -k*(a_i|a_j) is bounded, so optimal pair must involve large indices. This is justified by an exchange argument.
